def inference_detector_portable(model, filepath):
    """Keep the official inference path while adding MLU tensor placement.

    mmdetection 2.x only scatters inputs when ``Tensor.is_cuda`` is true.
    Cambricon tensors have ``device.type == 'mlu'`` instead, so the upstream
    helper leaves its image tensor on CPU.  CUDA and CPU continue to use the
    untouched upstream helper; only MLU uses this minimal placement shim.
    """
    device = next(model.parameters()).device
    if device.type != "mlu":
        return inference_detector(model, filepath)
    cfg = model.cfg.copy()
    cfg.data.test.pipeline = replace_ImageToTensor(cfg.data.test.pipeline)
    pipeline = Compose(cfg.data.test.pipeline)
    data = pipeline(dict(img_info=dict(filename=filepath), img_prefix=None))
    data = collate([data], samples_per_gpu=1)
    data["img_metas"] = [meta.data[0] for meta in data["img_metas"]]
    data["img"] = [image.data[0].to(device) for image in data["img"]]
    for module in model.modules():
        assert not isinstance(module, RoIPool), "MLU inference with RoIPool is unsupported"
    with torch.no_grad():
        return model(return_loss=False, rescale=True, **data)[0]
